topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I figured it out, you see, a way to make the world just a little bit better. It wasn't easy; it took nights of scribbling and days of tinkering. The pieces finally clicked into place, and there it was, my invention, perfect and new. Or so I thought. The letter came, plain and simple, telling me I was too late. Someone else had already laid claim to the very thing I created. It's funny how a piece of paper can make your creation feel smaller, less real. I guess I'll go back to my drawing board, find another puzzle to solve. Maybe next time, I won't be late.
